  1. Requirements definition
  2. REQ-G70-US-ID-05

Navigation and voice assistant that get it right the first time

Proposal
1, implement. Navigation is level A (28 rows) with the study at 4.85 vs peer 5.53; the personal assistant is level A (23 rows) linked to voice recognition (4.76 vs 4.99).
Horizon
H1. Software over the air.
Domain
Infotainment & Digital Services
Markets
US
Evidence level
A (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1

Statement

Route guidance shall give lane advice early and clearly on multi-lane highways, and the voice assistant shall understand natural phrasing of common commands without exact wording.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USStudy navigation (1-7)>= 5.5 (today 4.85, peer 5.53)Next US customer study waveevidence
USVoice command success on a 50-command natural-language test set>= 90 %Voice test protocolassumption
